description.value:
Grafted toxin pores across the palms and forearms. 1 action, once per 10 minutes: sweat a coat of toxin over one held weapon or your unarmed strikes. For 1 minute, Strikes with it deal an extra 1d4 poison (2d4 at 9th level, 3d4 at 17th).

Donor: A poisoner. The glands prefer the recipes they already know — the GM may rule what "flavour" comes out.

cinderfall.incomplete: A once-per-10-minutes activated weapon coating that adds persistent poison to Strikes for 1 minute is a limited-use activated buff -- needs a granted Action item (to apply the coating) plus an effect keyed to the Strike (to carry the rider), the same two-part gap flagged on the concealment/cover clauses elsewhere in this pass, compounded by the frequency.
